cves: SuiteCRM through 7.15.2 and 8.10.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the DetailUserRole entry point that allows authenticated non-admin users to view other users' ACL data. Attackers can supply another non-admin user's id in the record parameter to read that user's assigned roles and per-module ACL action matrix.
